scenarios.title: Vault: a gold reveal buys the scrolls and reveals every held item
scenarios.provenance: SETUP (CHEATED, mechanics only): level, gold and stash gold by stat verbs; the unidentified vault records are real magic items given by `debug give ... unid` and taken into the vault by the runner WITHOUT held affixes (bare: the shape of a record the fork sent none for), so the gold order must decode their own bytes (`item decode`). UNMEASURED run: the reveal pays from the stash with `debug paygold` (ADR 0029), a player-paid write the fork refuses under --lockstep, so the bot phase runs d2d in real time with --vault-pay; the one paygold write per order is the thing under test. Mechanics evidence only, never balance.

assert.why: 6 reveals at the Scroll of Identify price (80) left the stash: 7200 - 480 = 6720

scenarios.notes: Hero in town, 6 unidentified held items (vault records), 5000 gold in the purse and none in the stash, knob loot.vaultRevealGold 1, an order for all 6 posted before the first town visit. Expected: all 6 records identified, the purse down by about 6 scrolls at the vendor price (80 each) and not below the potion-kit reserve, no item sold, the order ends done. RED on today's main is the order route not existing; GREEN is the physical chain buy, read, supersede. Records are bare (no held affixes): the order decodes each record's own bytes, pays from the stash and reveals in the same request; no scroll, no town visit, no item created in the hero.
